Several days (random raids and missions with a 2 h to 20 h cooldown)

{npc:Eustacio}, a merchant from Venore, wants to climb the social ladder by defeating the {wiki:Pirats}. Help him repel Pirat raids all over Tibia, discover the island of {wiki:Rascacoon}, earn the trust of the Rascoohan and face {creature:Tentugly's Head} and {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers} in {wiki:The Wreckoning}. In parallel, follow the trail of a hidden Corym treasure. You receive the {wiki:Krakoloss} mount, a Familiar for your vocation, the Rascoohan outfit and two achievements.
Eustacio wants to climb Venore's social ladder and plans to defeat the Pirats to gain reputation among the merchants.
Eustacio, at the port of Venore
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 250** (Tentugly and Ratmiral are strong bosses).
Team of up to 5 players for the Supply Mission, The Journey, Tentugly and Ratmiral (for the Supply Mission the full team is recommended).
ask Eustacio for it (Ship Attack raids)
to break rocks and get Ballistic Boulders
Tentugly's loot; you need it to open the treasure chest
if you don't have Levitate (Stealth Mission)
protection against Life Drain on Ratmiral (very useful)
Familiar and figurine according to vocation: {wiki:Mossmasher} (druid), {wiki:Sandscourge} (paladin), {wiki:Snowbash} (knight), {wiki:Bladespark} (sorcerer) or {wiki:Moonhunter} (monk)
Basic {wiki:Rascoohan Outfits|Rascoohan} outfit (addons with {item:Soap} and {item:Scrubbing Brush}, Ratmiral's loot)
Access to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he}'s special shop of Rascoohan goods
When you reach **1500 points** with {npc:Eustacio} in the Pirat raids, he tells you about the secret passage from Issavi.
After visiting the island and talking to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} for the first time: ask {npc:Eustacio} for {key:shortcut} at the port of Venore; to come back, use the small boat at the island's dock.

With **1200 Trust Points** from {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} and after defeating {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly} on the first trip; after that you return on {npc:Captain Jack Rat}'s ship ({key:sail}, {key:safe}, {key:yes}) without repeating the boss.
Tik'hi Tak'he's special shop of Rascoohan goods
After you reach the Pirats' hideout (The Wreckoning).
On your first victory against {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly}.
The quest has two lines: the main one (Eustacio → Rascacoon → Tentugly → Ratmiral) and the hidden treasure one (Rita → Sniff → Ra'Clette → Queso → The Journey). You can progress on both in parallel.
Ask Eustacio {key:location} to find out whether there is an active raid and where, and {key:status} to see your points.
For Ra'Clette's part you need to already have Eustacio's trust (the 1500 raid points).
The Stealth Mission, the Supply Mission and the victory over Ratmiral give lots of Trust Points; the Memory Test can be repeated every 2 hours.
You need **1500 points** in Pirat raids. Raids appear in random places and types; a new raid starts **30 minutes** after the previous one ends.
Go to the **Venore** harbour (ground floor) and talk to {npc:Eustacio}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} to offer help against the Pirats.
Before you leave, ask him for {key:orb} to receive a {item:Magical Water Orb} and {key:flintstone} to receive a {item:Greenish Flintstone}. Both are needed in the raids.
Find out where the raid is
Ask Eustacio {key:location} to find out whether and where there is an active raid. Raids can happen in these 5 locations:
East of Thais (east of the Bloodhall guildhall)

The {creature:Spyrat|Spyrats} appear in the water near the coast. Use the {item:Magical Water Orb} on the water to create an underwater platform and build a path of platforms to them. Each Spyrat you attack gives **5 points** (you don't need to do the most damage). The raid ends when **60 Spyrats** die (*"The pirats used the big wave to flee!"*).
Spyrat raid: platforms created with the Magical Water Orb

A large ship anchors near the coast. To fend it off: 1) use a {item:Pick} on the nearby rocks to get {item:Ballistic Boulder|Ballistic Boulders}; 2) load the boulders into the catapults; 3) light them with the {item:Greenish Flintstone}; 4) pull the lever to fire. There is a 5-second cooldown between shots, but you can reload and light right after firing. The raid ends after **50 shots** (*"You fended off the attack! The ship is gone."*).

The Pirats invade the area and you have to defeat them. Each Pirat you attack gives **3 points** (you don't need to do the most damage). The raid ends when **100 Pirats** die (*"You pushed them back! The pirats ran away."*).
Ask {npc:Eustacio} {key:status}. When you have **1500 points**, he tells you about a secret passage that he believes leads to the Pirats' hideout.
The secret passage actually leads to Rascacoon's island, which is also suffering from Pirat attacks.

Travel to **Issavi**, on Kilmaresh island: there is a boat from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** or **Oramond** (say {key:hi}, {key:issavi} and {key:yes} to the captain) and you can also go by magic carpet. In Issavi, use the small shell **north of the depot**.
Shell north of the Issavi depot

Careful: near this spot, north of the temple, there is a trap hole. If you walk over it (for example while moving about the map), you fall next to a group of {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators}, who easily kill a level 100 mage.
Follow the path in the cave: go down at the first point, up at the second and up again at the third until you reach the island's surface.
Go up here (exit to the island)
To return to Issavi this way, take the same path in reverse through the cave. After talking to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} you get a faster shortcut (next step).

On the island, look for {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} to the **west** and offer him {key:help}. He asks you to help the villagers with various tasks to earn **Trust Points**. You can see your points by asking {key:trust points}. You need **1200 Trust Points** to move on to Tentugly.

After you have visited the island and talked to Tik'hi Tak'he for the first time, you get a shortcut: to go to the island ask {npc:Eustacio} {key:shortcut}, at the Venore harbour. To return, use the small boat on the dock where you arrive from Venore: it takes you back to Venore.
Collect 1200 Trust Points with these tasks. **The Journey** also gives 200 points, but only becomes available once you reach the Queso part of the hidden treasure (section 7).
These are the tasks that give Trust Points:

Find the big room inside the mountain, in the **centre** of the island. A few seconds after you enter, the room closes and the test begins. A pattern of **Pieces of Shells**, **Spiral Shells** and **Starfishes** appears in the centre: memorise it. When it disappears, several patterns appear around the centre: quickly find the one you saw and stay near it until the round ends (each pattern's area is bounded by the rubble on the floor; you don't need to be right on top of it).
The possible Memory Test patterns (they are always the same, in the same positions)

Focus on just two of the three types of objects and their positions. There is always a diagonal with 3 Starfishes or Spiral Shells: memorise it and the leftover 2-object diagonal and you will have a unique pattern.
5 Trust Points per correct round (up to 10 rounds in a row = 50); if you get it wrong you are kicked out; repeatable every 2 hours
Stealth Mission: talk to the Spy Rat

Inside the Pirats' cave, talk to {npc:Eustacio's Spy Rat} and ask him {key:advantage} (you can follow the whole conversation: {key:loud}, {key:job}, {key:people}, {key:assistance}, {key:disguise}, {key:convincing}, {key:advantage}). After the instructions, enter the teleport. You can bring 2 more players, but that doesn't change the chances of success.
Stealth Mission: cross without being seen

You have to cross the room without being detected by the {creature:Pirat Guard|Pirat Guards} and {creature:Pirat Patrol|Pirat Patrols}. If you step on a square **next to** one of them, you are kicked out. The Guards don't move; the Patrols walk back and forth along a fixed path, so watch them. By the towers, only pass when the **Wall Lamp is off** (the lamps flash before turning on and off). In some places you have to go up and down with {spell:Levitate}. Follow the map: the coins mark the path and the {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} mark the stretches where you have to watch the lamps.
Stealth Mission path (Platinum Coins = stretches with Wall Lamps)
You have **5 minutes** (countdown in seconds below your character's name).
Supply Mission: talk to Om'Wake Naha
Just **north** of Tik'hi Tak'he, find {npc:Om'Wake Naha} and ask him {key:helping}. Enter the teleport next to him: you arrive at a lever with places for 5 players. The full team is recommended.

On entering the room, use the chest beside you and pick up the {item:Racoohan Rat Revealer} that appears on the floor. The goal is to push the cheeses into the open trapdoor in the centre and protect them from the rats that appear. To attack a rat, first use the Revealer on it (it becomes vulnerable). You can also lure them onto the piles of rocks to make them disappear. You track the score on the counter under your name.
Have one or two players push the cheeses just close to the trapdoor and the rest of the team deal with the rats around the room: they "eat" the cheese quickly and that costs you points.

With **1200 Trust Points** or more, talk to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} again about your mission ({key:mission} / {key:trust points}) and say {key:yes}. He casts a permanent enchantment on you that turns you into a pirat for 15 minutes whenever you pass through the Pirats' teleport. The 1200 points are deducted.
Permanent access to the Pirats' teleport and, once you reach the hideout, to Tik'hi Tak'he's Rascoohan shop

Go to the teleport in the **southeast** of the island and enter. Go up **one floor** and talk to {npc:Captain Jack Rat}, who invites you on a voyage to the Pirats' hideout — with the risk of meeting the sea monster Tentugly. Up to **5 players** can take part. Pull the lever to start.
Teleport in the southeast of the island
You have **8 minutes** to defeat Tentugly before you are kicked out.

You stand in the centre of a boat facing {creature:Tentugly's Head}. {creature:Servant of Tentugly|Servants of Tentugly} appear around the boat: ignore them or kill them and then focus your attack on the head until it retreats. Soon after, lots of {creature:Tentacle|Tentacles} appear around the boat. Kill them one by one: each defeated tentacle retreats one square. Keep going until all of them are eliminated (there are also tentacles on the upper floor). Then the head comes back: kill it to receive the reward. Equip **energy** protection.
Don't stand in the areas where tentacles are emerging: they will probably spawn there and you get teleported to the temple with the message *"You had to leave the area because of strange events."*
First victory: Krakoloss mount and the Release the Kraken achievement. Tentugly may drop the Cheesy Key (you need it for the treasure).
When you leave the boat you arrive at {wiki:The Wreckoning}, the Pirats' hideout, an island north of Kilmaresh. You can leave through the teleport or explore the island.

After Tentugly, to return to The Wreckoning you don't have to repeat the boss: go to {npc:Captain Jack Rat}'s ship (go up one floor from the southeast teleport on Rascacoon) and say {key:sail}, {key:safe}, {key:yes}.

The fight has 4 phases; the first is the most dangerous. In the first 3 there is a miniboss that disappears before dying; in the last one they all come back to help Ratmiral. Equip **Life Drain** protection.

In The Wreckoning, when you are ready, enter this teleport. If you leave the island, you can return to The Wreckoning by going to {npc:Captain Jack Rat}'s ship and saying {key:sail}, {key:safe}, {key:yes}.

Destroy the {creature:Weak Spot} on the gate to the **north** of the room. Drag the {creature:Rum Barrel} that appears to the **northeast** close to the Weak Spot and wait for it to explode. The barrel and the gate only take considerable damage from **Life Drain**: the {creature:Pirat Artillerist|Pirat Artillerists} scattered around the room fire a GFB-style Life Drain attack that hits both. At the same time you face {creature:Rateye Ric} (ranged attacker) and several {creature:Elite Pirat|Elite Pirats}; the blocker should challenge them.
Don't walk near the {creature:Smelly Cheese|Smelly Cheeses}: they deal constant damage around them.

Faster: everyone next to the gate and one person pushing the barrel (a single Rum Barrel is enough, because the Artillerists also damage the Weak Spot), but it is dangerous for low levels and mages. Safer: players spread out (2 to the east, 2 to the west, blocker in the centre); they take less damage, but you probably need 2 barrels (the barrel respawns shortly after exploding). {item:Necklace of the Deep|Necklaces of the Deep} help a lot.

After opening the gate, head **north** to the ship and fight {creature:Mister Catkiller}. This phase lasts about 30 seconds; then a staircase to the upper floor appears. Stay alert for the Elite Pirats and the Smelly Cheeses.
Climb the stairs to the main deck and face {creature:1st Mate Ratticus}. He also disappears shortly after the start, and the final phase begins.

Finally fight {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers}. To avoid his fire waves, use the **bath tub** (Bath Tub) to the **northwest** of the room: each player gets 6 "water charges" that protect them from the boss's fire damage. It only works if Ratmiral is not near the bath tub, so the knight pulls him **east** and runs to the bath tub to recharge when needed. At **50%** health all the previous minibosses return: you can kill some of them quickly to make the fight safer, but the goal is Ratmiral.
You still have Smelly Cheeses, Elite Pirats and the Pirat Artillerists' Life Drain during this phase.

After killing Ratmiral, leave The Wreckoning through the exit teleport and return to Rascacoon, to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he}. Ask him {key:mission} to receive the basic **Rascoohan** outfit. The addons are obtained by using {item:Soap} and {item:Scrubbing Brush}, which Ratmiral drops.
Basic Rascoohan outfit; 100 Trust Points for each victory over Ratmiral
6. Hidden Treasure — the Corym siblings' rhyme
You can start this part before you have access to Rascacoon, but to get the treasure you need the {item:Cheesy Key} from Tentugly and to complete The Journey.

Travel to **Liberty Bay** and enter the {wiki:Corym Black Market}, the dungeon under the city: the entrance is a sewer grate ({item:Sewer Grate}) at this spot. To leave at the end, go back up the same way to the sewer grate and you return to the streets of Liberty Bay.
Bring a {item:Rope} in case you have to climb out of a hole on the way back.

Go down to the **4th floor** and go to the room to the **north**, where there is a chest with {item:Rita's Letter}. In the letter Rita talks about a treasure she found with her siblings on a small island. Each sibling keeps a part of a rhyme, needed to pass the magic portal that protects the treasure.
Go to the room **southwest** of the chest and talk to the parrot {npc:Larry}. Ask him {key:Rita}: the Quest Log is updated and he tells you that one of the siblings, {npc:Sniff}, is in Venore.

In **Venore**, go to the **east** exit and go down the stairs to the ground floor. Offer {key:help} to {npc:Sniff}: he asks you to recover the belongings he lost at sea south of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}.
Go to the Plains of Havoc beach

Walk to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc}, between Thais and Venore (east of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}), and go down to a small beach far to the **south**. After picking up the bag, swim back along the same safe path to the beach and walk back to Venore.
Beach south of the Plains of Havoc
To recover the belongings you have to swim in the bay, which has sharks. Follow the path on the map **exactly** to the barrel (Cask) and use it to recover the {item:Bag of Smuggled Goods}.
Safe path between the sharks to the Cask
If you get the path wrong you take 500 damage and are pushed back to the beach.
Go back to {npc:Sniff} and say {key:hi}, {key:help}, {key:yes}. He tells you where his sister, {npc:Ra'Clette}, is and gives you the second part of the poem: **'Mould is blue!'**.

Leave Venore into the swamp to the **east**. {npc:Ra'Clette} is above the cave of the {creature:Little Corym Charlatan|Little Corym Charlatans}. Offer her {key:help}: she wants a personal object of {npc:Eustacio}'s to make a voodoo doll of him.

If you already have Eustacio's trust (raids), ask him {key:house}: he gives you access and marks the house on your minimap. In the house, open the {item:Chest of Drawers} and you find a {item:Lace-Trimmed Handkerchief}.
Take the handkerchief to {npc:Ra'Clette}. She gives you her part of the rhyme and sends you to **Thais** to look for the last sibling, Queso.
Queso: the inscriptions in Thais jail

Go to **Thais** jail ({wiki:Thais Jail|Thais Jail}, in the **south** of the city, on Harbour Street) and go down one floor to where {npc:Henricus} is. In a cell on your **left** there are inscriptions on a wall: use them to find out Queso's part of the rhyme. To leave, go back up the same stairs.
The Journey only becomes available once you reach the Queso part. To open the chest at the end you need the {item:Cheesy Key} from Tentugly. Use **energy** damage.

Enter the teleport **north** of Rascacoon island. Up to 5 players can go. The goal is to protect the raft for **10 minutes** from attacks and obstacles. The raft's health appears as a small number below your health bar; if it reaches zero, you fail. {npc:Captain Coohan} shouts warnings for each event; the events repeat over the 10 minutes (the order may vary slightly).
React to each of the captain's warnings:
{creature:Gust of Wind|Gusts of Wind} (lots of energy damage)

Lure them onto the grate next to the mast (it gives the raft health). Put {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls} and {item:Wild Growth Rune|Wild Growths} north and south of the grate and walk from east to west to guide them.
Rubbish floating in from the west
Use the raft's cannons (they are not automatic: wait for the rubbish to get close). It lasts the whole event: take turns on the left side.
Kill them with energy or death damage (they resist most other elements).
{creature:Sea Serpent (Journey)|Sea Serpent} to the north or south
Dodge or block the wave (300–600 physical damage). Protect the {creature:Raccoon Supplies} with magic walls.
They want to destroy the Raccoon Supplies. Energy Bombs don't work: knights use {spell:Challenge} and the group kills them quickly.
Kill them straight away, starting with the ones near the mast: each bite takes 5 health from the raft.

After completing the journey you arrive at a small island. Use the portal to pass into the protected area and open the chest (you need the {item:Cheesy Key}). You receive a new Familiar and its figurine, depending on your vocation:
Familiar and figurine for your vocation

The wiki doesn't describe the exit from the treasure island: after the chest, go back through the portal of the protected area and look for the way off the island. If you can't find it, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your city's temple.
A new Pirat raid starts 30 minutes after the previous one ends; the type and location are random.
The Rascoohan outfit addons are obtained with {item:Soap} and {item:Scrubbing Brush}, which Ratmiral Blackwhiskers drops.
After you reach the Pirats' hideout, Tik'hi Tak'he starts selling you from his special shop of Rascoohan goods.
